title: Insurance submission mapping v1
description: Extract explicitly supported facts from one application or quote into this target payload. Unknown or unresolved conflicting scalar values are null. Unknown lists are null; [] means explicitly known to contain no items. Preserve source roles and monetary bases. Do not infer missing facts from boilerplate or other documents.

legal_name.description: Legal name of the applicant or named insured. Exclude the broker, carrier, contact person, and trade name. If the document gives conflicting insured identities without resolving them, return null.

dba.description: Doing-business-as or trading name, only when supplied separately.

addresses.description: Addresses explicitly associated with the insured. Exclude broker and carrier addresses. Include each distinct address-role pair once; do not assume an office address is a mailing address.

effective_date.description: Requested or quoted policy inception date, not the application submission or quote issue date.

expiration_date.description: Policy expiration date, not the date until which a quotation remains valid.

attorney_count.description: Number of attorneys. Never substitute all employees or infer attorney count for a different type of business.

year_established.description: Year this business was established; not years of experience.

annual_payroll.description: Stated annual payroll as a number. Not revenue, premiums, or inferred employee compensation.

practice_areas.description: Selected or answered practice areas only. Exclude unselected options printed on the form. Percentages refer to the measure stated in the source; do not assume blanks are zero.

name.description: Practice-area label as written in the source, with surrounding whitespace removed.

percentage.description: Percentage in percentage points: 50 means 50%, not 0.5. Use null if not supplied.

real_estate_closings_or_escrow.description: Whether the firm conducts real estate closings or handles escrow funds. Map explicit Yes/No to true/false; unanswered is null.

client_trust_account.description: Whether the firm maintains a client trust account (IOLTA or equivalent). Do not infer it from escrow or practice areas.

claims_in_past_5_years.description: Whether professional-services claims, suits, or demands occurred in the past 5 years. Do not substitute a question with another time window.

coverage_terms.description: One item per explicitly supplied numeric limit, deductible, or retention row in an account-specific quote/schedule. Exclude boilerplate examples, unselected options, statutory/non-numeric rows, and unresolved template placeholders. Preserve combined bases such as Each Occurrence / Aggregate as one row; never assign one amount to two separate bases without evidence.

coverage.description: Coverage section heading in source wording.

component.description: Source subheading or row label, such as Employers Liability or Limit of Liability. Carry forward a merged table cell only within its section.

term_type.description: Keep deductibles and retentions distinct; do not rename a retention as a deductible.

basis.description: Basis in source wording, such as Each Claim, Aggregate, or Bodily Injury by Disease - Each Employee. Preserve substantive qualifiers.

amount.description: Numeric money amount without grouping separators or currency symbols.
Explicit total annual policy premium. Exclude taxes and fees unless included in the stated total. Do not calculate a total from components or infer it from payroll.

date.description: ISO calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, or null when missing/ambiguous. Normalize only when the source date convention is established.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code only when identified for this amount by the source section or an explicit document-wide statement. A dollar symbol or US address alone does not establish USD. Otherwise null.

role.description: Role explicitly stated for this insured address; use unspecified when no role is stated.

state.description: State/province code or name supplied by the source. Do not guess from city or ZIP.

postal_code.description: Preserve postal codes as strings, including leading zeros.
